EN:
Depending on what you ask your Dwellers to do, they can become happy or sad.

Keeping Dwellers happy is very important! A happy Vault runs more efficiently and produces resources faster.
You can see a specific Dweller's happiness by checking their profile.

Happiness Icon status:

GREEN: Your Dweller is happy, way to go!

YELLOW: Your Dweller is doing okay, but could be happier.

RED: Your Dweller is sad, cheer them up!
ZH:
您让居民做的事情会让他们变得开心或者难过。

保持居民的幸福度是很重要的！一个幸福度高的避难所会更有效率，资源生产得更快。
您可以在居民的个人信息查看他们的幸福度。

幸福度图标状态：

绿色：您的居民很开心，做得好！

黄色：您的居民感觉还行，但还可以更好。

红色：您的居民很难过，赶紧让他们振作起来！

EN: DWELLER HAPPINESS
ZH: 居民幸福度

EN: Hint: Playing for 7 days gives you a Lunchbox as a reward.
ZH: 提示：连续登录七天将会获得午餐盒奖励。

EN:
Every day you receive a reward based on how happy your Vault is.

- Your Vault rating is the combined total of all your Dwellers happiness. 

- Your reward is based on your Vault Rating.

- A high Vault Rating earns you bonus CAPS.
ZH:
每天系统都会依据避难所居民的开心程度发放相应奖励。

- 您的避难所评级将会结合所有居民的幸福度。 

- 您的奖励是基于避难所每天的评级。

- 避难所评级越高，获得的瓶盖奖励就越高。

EN: DAILY REPORT & VAULT RATING
ZH: 每日报告和避难所评级

EN: Hint: Babies will wait to be born if there is no space in your Vault.
ZH: 提示：如果避难所没有空位，宝宝会等到有空间时才出生。

EN:
When you need new Dwellers you can always encourage your Dwellers to procreate.

- Put a man and a woman in the Living Quarters and see if they like each other.

- If all goes well, the woman will become pregnant.

- After some time, the pregnant Dweller will be ready to give birth.

- Tap the icon above her head to welcome a new child in your Vault.

- Once the child has grown up, you will have a new Dweller.
ZH:
当您需要新居民时，您可以鼓励您的居民多生育。

- 将一个男人和女人放在宿舍里，看看他们是不是喜欢对方。

- 如果一切顺利的话，女方将会怀孕。

- 过一段时间，怀孕的居民就可以分娩了。

- 点击她头上的图标，会有新的小孩出生。

- 一旦孩子长大，您将拥有一个新的居民。

EN:
When you need new Dwellers you can always encourage your Dwellers to procreate.

- Put a man and a woman in the Living Quarters and see if they like each other.

- If all goes well, the woman will become pregnant.

- After some time, the pregnant Dweller will be ready to give birth.

- Click on the icon above her head to welcome a new child in your Vault.

- Once the child has grown up, you will have a new Dweller.
ZH:
当您需要新居民时，您可以鼓励您的居民多生育。

- 将一个男人和女人放在宿舍里，看看他们是不是喜欢对方。

- 如果一切顺利的话，女方将会怀孕。

- 过一段时间，怀孕的居民就可以分娩了。

- 点击她头上的图标，会有新的小孩出生。

- 一旦孩子长大，您将拥有一个新的居民。

EN:
When you need new Dwellers you can always encourage your Dwellers to procreate.

- Put a man and a woman in the Living Quarters and see if they like each other.

- If all goes well, the woman will become pregnant.

- After some time, the pregnant Dweller will be ready to give birth. A baby icon will appear above her head.

- Select her to welcome a new child in your Vault.

- Once the child has grown up, you will have a new Dweller.
ZH:
当您需要新居民时，您可以鼓励您的居民多生育。

- 将一个男人和女人放在宿舍里，看看他们是不是喜欢对方。

- 如果一切顺利的话，女方将会怀孕。

- 过一段时间，怀孕的居民就可以分娩了。一个婴儿的图标会出现在她头上。

- 选择她，然后欢迎一个新生命诞生在避难所。

- 一旦孩子长大，您将拥有一个新居民。

EN: MAKING BABIES & LIVING QUARTERS
ZH: 宿舍和生小孩

EN: Hint: Be careful not to build rooms before you need them, or expand too fast.
ZH: 提示：请记住不要建造超出需求的房间，或者扩张得过快。

EN:
Build Living Quarters to welcome new Dwellers to your Vault.

- Expand your Vault by building rooms so you can produce more resources.

- Pay attention to the Vault Resource Gauges, they are a good indicator to follow when choosing the next room to build.

- Build an Elevator when you want to expand downwards.

- You can not delete a room if it is connected on both sides.

- Building multiple types of the same room will increase its price.
ZH:
建造宿舍，诞生更多的新居民。

- 建造更多房间来扩大您的避难所，生产更多的资源。

- 注意避难所资源的标尺。在选择下一间要建造的房间时，它们是很好的参考。

- 想要向下扩张时，请建造电梯。

- 与两侧都相连的房间无法拆除。

- 同种房间建造得越多就越贵。

EN: BUILD YOUR VAULT & ELEVATOR
ZH: 建造您的避难所和电梯

EN: Hint: A room merge only happens if all rooms are of the same level.
ZH: 提示：当房间的等级一致时才能合并。

EN:
Upgrade your Rooms to increase their performance.

- Most Rooms can be upgraded twice. Upgraded resource rooms produce more resources.

- Up to 3 Rooms of the same type can be merged, by building them next to each other

- Merged Rooms let you assign more Dwellers to the room, while also becoming more efficient.

- Some rooms, like Workshops, begin as larger rooms and cannot be merged.

- Themes can only be applied to fully merged and upgraded Diners and Living Quarters.
ZH:
升级您的房间，来提高它们的性能。

- 大多数房间都可以升级两次。升级的资源房间能够生产更多资源。

- 同类型的房间最多可以合并三个，只要将它们建在彼此相邻的位置即可。

- 合并的房间能容纳更多居民，同时效率也会更高。

- 有些房间，比如工坊，开始就是一个大房间，是不能合并的。

- 主题只能应用于完全合并并升级至顶级的餐厅和宿舍。

EN: ROOM LEVEL & MERGING
ZH: 房间等级和合并

EN: Hint: If you run out of storage space, upgrade your storage, build more storage, equip your Dwellers or sell items.
ZH: 提示：如果储藏空间不够，您可以升级您的储藏室，建造更多的储藏室，给您的居民穿戴装备或是卖掉它们。

EN:
Storage Rooms increase your Weapons, Outfit, Junk and Pets inventory space.

- Upgrade your Storage Rooms to increase inventory capacity.

- Sell unwanted items by visiting the inventory from the Pip-Boy menu.

- Scrap Weapons and Outfits to turn them into Junk from their Recipes.

- Use the Storage Room as a temporary holding bay for Dwellers in case all other Rooms are full.

- Building MedBays and Science Labs will increase the number of Stimpaks and RadAway you can store.
ZH:
储藏室会增加您的武器，装备，杂物和宠物的存储空间。

- 升级储藏室，增加存储容量。

- 通过哔哔小子菜单访问库存，卖掉不想要的物品。

- 分解武器和装备，可按对应配方获得杂物。

- 如果其他房间都满员的话，储藏室可用来暂时安置居民。

- 建造医务室和实验室能增加治疗针和消辐宁的持有量。

EN:
Storage Rooms increase your Weapons, Outfit, Junk and Pets inventory space.

- Upgrade your Storage Rooms to increase inventory capacity.

- Sell unwanted items by visiting the inventory from the Pip-Boy menu. You can also open the inventory with 3D Touch by pressing on a Storage Room.

- Scrap Weapons and Outfits to turn them into Junk from their Recipes.

- Use the Storage Room as a temporary holding bay for Dwellers in case all other Rooms are full.

- Building MedBays and Science Labs will increase the number of Stimpaks and RadAway you can store.
ZH:
储藏室会增加您的武器，装备，杂物和宠物的存储空间。

- 升级储藏室，增加存储容量。

- 通过哔哔小子菜单访问库存，卖掉不想要的物品。您还可以通过3D Touch重按储藏室来打开库存。

- 分解武器和装备，将其变回配方中的杂物。

- 如果其他房间都满员的话，储藏室可用来暂时安置居民。

- 建造医务室和实验室能增加治疗针和消辐宁的持有量。

EN: STORAGE ROOM
ZH: 储藏室

EN: Hint: Multiple Dwellers training together in the same room decrease the training time for all Dwellers in the room.
ZH: 提示：多名居民一起训练能缩短训练房间里所有居民的训练时间。

EN:
Putting Dwellers in a Training Room will increase their SPECIAL stats.

There is a Training Room for each one of the SPECIAL stats.

Strength: Weight Room
Perception: Armory
Endurance: Fitness Room
Charisma: Lounge
Intelligence: Classroom
Agility: Athletics Room 
Luck: Game Room

You can raise each stat up to 10.

The higher the SPECIAL stat of a Dweller is, the longer it takes them to train to the next level, but you can use Nuka-Cola Quantum to speed up the training time.
ZH:
将居民放进训练房间里将会提升他们的SPECIAL属性。

每一个属性都有对应的训练房间。

力量：举重房
观察力：军械库
耐力：健身房
魅力：会客室
智力：教室
敏捷：体操房
运气：棋牌室

每个属性最高能提升到10点。

居民的属性值越高，训练到下一级所需的时间就越长，但您可以使用量子核子可乐来加速训练。

EN: TRAINING ROOMS
ZH: 训练房间

EN: Hint: Merging the Radio Room increases your chances of attracting a Dweller.
ZH: 提示：合并广播室将会增加吸引外来居民的概率。

EN:
The Radio Room attracts new Dwellers from the Wasteland.

- Periodically, Radio Rooms send out a call for new Dwellers. There's a chance that the call will be answered.

- When the timer in the Radio Room reaches zero, if a new Dweller doesn't answer the call, the timer will restart automatically.

- Assign Dwellers with high Charisma to a Radio Room to speed up the Radio Call.

- Upgrade your Radio Room to increase the chance of attracting Dwellers.

- The Radio Call can also lead Deathclaws to your Vault.

- If you don't want any new Dwellers, you can stop a Radio Room from calling out.

- Having Dwellers in the Radio Room also provides a happiness boost to your Vault, whether or not it's calling for new Dwellers.
ZH:
广播室能吸引来自废土的新居民。

- 广播室会周期性地发出信号，召唤新居民加入。有时会收到回应。

- 如果广播室的计时器走到零还没有新的居民回应，计时器会自动重启。

- 将魅力值高的居民分配在广播室能够加速信号的发出。

- 升级广播室能增加吸引新居民的概率。

- 广播信号也可能把死爪引到您的避难所。

- 如果您不想吸引新居民，可以让广播室停止呼叫。

- 在广播室里分配居民能够提升避难所的整体幸福度，无论广播室是否正在招募新居民。

EN: NEW DWELLERS & RADIO ROOM
ZH: 广播室和新居民

EN: Hint: Rushing a room is the fastest way to earn CAPS.
ZH: 提示：启动极速模式是最快赚取瓶盖的方法。

EN:
There are lots of ways you can earn CAPS.
- Find them in the Wasteland and on Quests
- Complete Objectives
- Level up Dwellers
- Sell items
- Every Lunchbox contains CAPS
- Lucky Dwellers earn them occasionally while collecting resources 

CAPS can be spent to:
- Build Rooms and elevators
- Destroy rocks 
- Upgrade Rooms
- Revive Dwellers
- Craft Weapons, Outfits and Themes
- Customize Dwellers
ZH:
有许多方式可以赚取瓶盖。
- 在废土和任务中找到
- 完成目标
- 居民升级
- 贩卖物品
- 每个午餐盒里都有一定数量的瓶盖
- 一些幸运的居民在收集资源时偶尔能获得瓶盖

一些动作需要花费瓶盖。
- 建造房间和电梯
- 摧毁岩石
- 升级房间
- 复活居民
- 打造武器、装备和主题
- 个性化居民

EN: CAPS
ZH: 瓶盖

EN: Hint: The percentage chance of a disaster cools down over time.
ZH: 提示：灾害出现的概率随着时间会慢慢降低。

EN:
Production Rooms can be Rushed to earn CAPS and to instantly earn resources.

- Rush completes the current production cycle and award a bonus amount of CAPS.

- The CAPS bonus is based on the Risk value. The higher the risk is, the greater the amount of CAPS you earn.

- Failing a Rush causes a disaster in the room.
ZH:
生产型房间能够启动极速模式来赚取瓶盖，同时即时产生资源。

- 极速模式会立即完成当前的生产周期然后发放一定瓶盖奖励。

- 瓶盖奖励是基于风险值。风险越大，奖励越多。

- 极速模式如果失败，会导致灾害发生。

EN: RUSH MODE
ZH: 极速模式

EN: Hint: A Dweller in the Wasteland can be Revived for CAPS.
ZH: 提示：废土的居民能够通过瓶盖复活。

EN:
Dispatch your Dwellers to scavenge the Wasteland. 

Out there they will find CAPS, earn Experience, and bring back Weapons, Outfits and Junk. The further out they go, the better the rewards they'll find, but the harder the encounters will become.

- Drag a Dweller to the Wasteland and equip them with a Weapon, an Outfit, a Pet, RadAway and Stimpaks.

- Send them out exploring, but don't forget to check on their progress.

- Dwellers can be recalled from the Wasteland at any time, and take half as long to return from the Wasteland.

- Make sure you bring them home before they die!

- Dwellers automatically return from the Wasteland if they can't carry any more items.

- Dwellers in the Wasteland may stumble upon a special location. Tap the exclamation point icon to choose between entering this location and continuing to explore the Wasteland.
ZH:
派遣您的居民去探险废土。

在那里，他们会找到瓶盖，增长经验值，然后给避难所带回武器、装备和杂物。他们走的越远，找到的奖励就越好，不过遇到的困难也越多。

- 将一个居民拖到废土上，为他/她配备武器、装备、宠物、消辐宁和治疗针。

- 将他们送去探险。请不要忘记查看他们的动态。

- 送去废土的居民能随时被召回。返回的时间是去时的一半。

- 确保在生命值降到零之前召回他们，否则会死亡。

- 当居民无法再携带更多的物品时会自动返回。

- 废土上的居民可能会经过一个特殊的地点。点击他们头上的惊叹号图标来选择进入地点或继续探索废土。

EN:

- Dwellers automatically return from the Wasteland if they can't carry any more items.

ZH:
派遣您的居民去废土寻宝。

在外面他们会找到瓶盖，获得经验，并带回各种武器，装备和杂物。他们走得越远，找到的奖励就越好，当然遇到的困难也越大。

- 拖拽一个居民到废土，给他或她配备武器，装备，宠物，消辐宁和治疗针。

- 派他们出去探险，但不要忘了时刻查看他们的进度。

- 居民可以随时从废土召回，返程时间只需去程的一半。

- 确保在生命值降到零之前让他们回来！

- 如果他们再装不下任何物品了，居民会自动从废土返回。

- 废土上的居民可能会偶然发现一个特殊地点。点击他们头上的惊叹号图标，选择进入该地点或继续探索废土。

- 废土上的居民可能会偶然发现一个特殊地点。按来选择进入该地点或继续探索废土。

EN: THE WASTELAND
ZH: 废土

EN: Hint: Rare and Legendary Dwellers can be found in Lunchboxes and have great stats.
ZH: 提示：稀有和传奇级别的居民能在午餐盒中找到，他们的属性通常很强。

EN:
Fast-track your progress with Vault-Tec's amazing Lunchboxes.

DWELLERS - Need more Dwellers, fast? Each Lunchbox has a chance of containing a Dweller. 

WEAPONS - All the finest in Wasteland survival from BB guns to the powerful Fat Man. 

OUTFITS - Equip your Dwellers in these stat boosting, and stylish, outfits. 

PETS - Find a faithful companion that will help your Dwellers and liven up your Vault.

NUKA-COLA QUANTUM – Get things done fast with these refreshing beverages.

JUNK - Use these long-forgotten objects to craft items in your Workshops.

RESOURCES - Stock up on resources with CAPS, RadAway, Stimpaks, Extra Food, Power or Water

Every Lunchbox can give you COMMON, RARE, or LEGENDARY items. Each Lunchbox is guaranteed to either have a Dweller or a RARE item.
ZH:
避难所科技的午餐盒能加快您的进程。

居民- 需要更快获得更多居民？每个午餐盒都有机会抽到一个居民。

武器- 所有能在废土生存中用到的好东西。从BB枪到小型核武器“胖子”都有。

装备- 给您的居民穿上这些又能增强属性又有型的好装备。

宠物- 找到一位忠诚的伴侣，它会帮助您的居民，还能让您的避难所充满生机！

量子核子可乐- 用这种清爽的饮料快速搞定一切。

杂物- 在您的工坊里用这些被长时间遗忘的物件打造武器装备。

资源- 储备充足的瓶盖，消辐宁，治疗针，食物，水和电。

午餐盒里可能有普通，稀有或者传奇的物品。每个午餐盒至少会有一个居民或者稀有的物品。

EN: LUNCHBOXES
ZH: 午餐盒

EN: Hint: Equipping your Dwellers with Weapons will help fight off enemies.
ZH: 提示：给您的居民配备武器将有助于他们击退敌人。

EN:
Disasters can randomly strike your Vault at any time! Disasters also occur when you fail a room Rush. Watch out for these possible encounters:

FIRES - Put out fires quickly before they spread to other rooms.

RADROACHES - These pesky critters are hard to get rid of. Take them out before they spread.

RAIDERS - Raiders will rush through your Vault and destroy its resources, stop them quickly! Stronger Raiders will even steal CAPS if you're not careful! Upgrading your Vault Entrance will delay Raiders, giving you time to prepare. Putting guards in your Vault Entrance will also provide a front line of defense against the Raiders. You can loot dead Raiders for CAPS and items!

MOLE RATS – These pests are a nuisance and have a nasty habit of burrowing into your Vault from the dirt and chewing on any room's power cables. Kill them quickly, or they'll drain your Vault of Power!

DEATHCLAWS – Any time you open your Vault Door, you're broadcasting an invitation for these beasties to come to your Vault and destroy your resources. Be sure to have Stimpaks and Weapons at the ready, or they'll tear through your Dwellers like a knife through a Fancy Lad Snack Cake! 

FERAL GHOULS - Feral Ghouls run through your Vault, wreaking havoc by dealing both physical and radiation damage to the Dwellers they attack.

RADSCORPIONS – These mutated scorpions are able to burrow and attack random rooms in your Vault. Make sure to kill them quickly as their attacks also do radiation damage!

Children and Pregnant Women will hide whenever an incident occurs.
ZH:
您的避难所随时都会发生灾害！当极速模式失败时，也会造成灾害。灾害是随机的，请注意以下情况：

火灾-在火势蔓延到其他房间之前赶紧扑灭。

辐射蟑螂-这些磨人的小妖精很难被除掉。请在虫灾扩散前消灭它们。

掠夺者- 掠夺者们会闯入避难所然后破坏资源。赶紧阻止它们！如果不小心的话，强悍的掠夺者们还会偷走瓶盖！升级您的避难所入口将会使得掠夺者花费更长时间进入，因此给您更多时间准备。您可以派居民驻守入口，在他们进入时形成良好的前线防御。您可以从死亡的掠夺者身上掠夺瓶盖和物品！

鼹鼠- 这些坏蛋喜欢从土里挖进您的避难所，吃掉每个房间的电线。迅速消灭它们，不然您的电力将枯竭！

死爪-您每一次打开避难所的大门，都是在给这些野兽们发送邀请信息。它们会毫不留情地来避难所破坏资源。请备好充足的治疗针和武器，不然它们会像切蛋糕一样劈开您的居民！

狂尸鬼- 狂尸鬼会在您的避难所里四处跑动，制造混乱，给居民带来物理和辐射伤害。

辐射蝎- 这些变种的蝎子能钻洞，然后随机攻击避难所里任何的房间。请迅速解决掉它们，因为它们的攻击也会带来辐射伤害。

孕妇和孩子在灾害发生时会躲起来。

9. 目标- 点击缎带图标进入目标页面。一个感叹号表示有目标奖励可以领取。

EN: UI
ZH: 用户界面

EN: Hint: The positive and negative effects of your resources are amplified by their distance from the required resource lines.
ZH: 提示：资源与所需资源线偏离越远（无论超出或不足），正面或负面效果就越强。

EN:
Your FOOD, WATER and POWER resources are what keeps your Vault going.

- FOOD: Dwellers need to eat to stay healthy. Run low on FOOD and your Dwellers will begin to lose Health.

- WATER: Clean water is hard to come by in the Wasteland. Run low on WATER and your Dwellers will take Radiation damage.

- POWER: Your Vault can't run without POWER. Run low on POWER and your rooms will begin shutting down.

Keep your resources above the required resource lines to keep your Vault happy.
Resources continue to be consumed for a short time after closing the game.
ZH:
食物，水和电力资源是能保证避难所日常运行的基础。

-食物：居民需要食物才能保持健康。食物匮乏时，居民的生命值会降低。

-水：废土上很难获得干净的水。水资源匮乏时，居民会受到辐射伤害。

-电力：没有电，整个避难所都无法运转。电力不足时，房间将无法使用。

将您的资源维持在所需资源线之上，您的避难所才能保持愉快。

关闭游戏后，资源仍会继续消耗一小段时间。

EN: RESOURCES
ZH: 资源

EN: Hint: Drag a Dweller around to a few rooms to see where they'd work best.
ZH: 提示：尝试将居民多拖拽至几个不同的房间，看他/她最适合在哪里工作。

EN: Hint: Move a Dweller around to a few rooms to see where they'd work best.
ZH: 提示：尝试将居民多拖拽至几个不同的房间，看他/她最适合在哪里工作。

EN:
When you drag a Dweller into a room, a SPECIAL letter will appear above their head with a number.

The letter above their head corresponds to the SPECIAL stat associated with that room.

If the number is listed with a plus or minus sign, it means that dragging a Dweller into that room will replace a Dweller that is currently working in that room.

The Dweller's effect on that room will go up or down whatever the number is.

When a Dweller is replaced this way, they switch jobs with the Dweller being moved.

If there is no plus or minus sign it means there's room for the Dweller to work in the room without replacing any Dwellers.
ZH:
当您将居民拖拽到一个房间时，SPECIAL属性的字母会出现在头上，后面有一个数字。

头上的字母对应着相应房间的属性。

如果数字前有加号或者减号，意味着拖拽居民后，房间里原有的一位居民将被替换。该居民对房间的影响将随所标数字提高或降低。

房间里被替换居民将从事被拖拽居民之前的工作。

如果数字前没有加号或者减号，则意味着房间里还可以容纳更多的居民，无需替换。

EN:
You can assign a Dweller to a room by dragging them there, or by using 3D Touch to first press on the Dweller and then on the room.

When assigning a Dweller to a room, a SPECIAL letter will appear above their head with a number.

The letter above their head corresponds to the SPECIAL stat associated with that room.

If the number is listed with a plus or minus sign, it means that assigning the Dweller to that room will replace a Dweller that is currently working there.

The Dweller's effect on that room will go up or down whatever the number is.

When a Dweller is replaced this way, they switch jobs with the Dweller being moved.

If there is no plus or minus sign it means there's room for the Dweller to work in the room without replacing any Dwellers.

当将居民分配到一个房间时，SPECIAL属性的字母会出现在头上，后面跟着一个数字。

头上的字母对应着相应房间的属性。

如果数字前有加号或者减号，意味着拖拽居民后，房间里原有的一位居民将被替换。该居民对房间的影响将随所标数字提高或降低。

房间里被替换居民将从事被拖拽居民之前的工作。

如果数字前没有加号或者减号，则意味着房间里还可以容纳更多的居民，无需替换。

EN:
To assign a Dweller to a room, select them first, hold [A] to grab them, and then select a room.

While a room is highlighted, a SPECIAL letter with a number will appear above the Dweller's head.

The letter above their head corresponds to the SPECIAL stat associated with that room.

If the number is listed with a plus or minus sign, it means that assigning the Dweller to that room will replace a Dweller that is currently working there.

The Dweller's effect on that room will go up or down whatever the number is.

When a Dweller is replaced this way, they switch jobs with the Dweller being moved.

If there is no plus or minus sign it means there's room for the Dweller to work in the room without replacing any Dwellers.

要分配居民到房间，请先选中居民，按住将其抓起，然后再选择一个房间。

当选中一个房间时，SPECIAL属性的字母和数字会出现在居民头上。

头上的字母对应着相应房间的属性。

如果数字前有加号或者减号，意味着将居民分配到该房间后，房间里原有的一位居民将被替换。该居民对房间的影响将随所标数字提高或降低。

房间里被替换的居民将从事被拖拽居民之前的工作。

如果数字前没有加号或者减号，则意味着房间里还可以容纳更多的居民，无需替换。

EN: Hint: Build a bunch of production rooms on one floor to maximize Mr. Handy's ability.
ZH: 提示：在同一层建造很多生产房间来最大化利用巧手先生的能力。

EN:
Mr. Handys will collect resources on the floor they are assigned. They will even collect them for a time when you are not playing the game. There is a limit of one Mr. Handy per Vault floor.

Mr. Handy can also help fight Incidents, but be careful, Mr. Handy can be destroyed! Be sure to repair him if he falls apart. 

He can also be sent to the Wasteland to collect CAPS, but he won't face any encounters. 

You can only send a limited amount of Mr. Handys to the Wasteland.
ZH:
巧手先生将会自动收集所处楼层的资源。即使玩家退出游戏，它仍能继续收集。每层楼只能有一个巧手先生。

巧手先生也能对抗灾害，但要注意巧手先生也可能被摧毁。请注意在它破碎时维修。

巧手先生也能被派到废土上收集瓶盖，但它不会遇到任何冲突。

您只能派遣一定数量的巧手先生去废土。

EN: MR. HANDY
ZH: 巧手先生

EN: Hint: Survival Mode is not for the faint of heart. Be prepared!
ZH: 提示：生存模式可不是小孩子过家家。请做好准备！

EN:
Survival Mode is for players that want an extra layer of challenge. In this mode the same rules apply as in the main game but there are a few changes.

- Resources drain at a faster rate.

- Incidents do more damage.

- Dwellers can't be revived, whether in the Vault, in the Wasteland or on Quests.

- Objectives are more demanding but give better rewards.

- Quests are more challenging.
ZH:
生存模式是为喜欢额外挑战的玩家准备的。在此模式下，游戏规则与普通模式相同，只有以下几点变化：

- 资源会消耗得更快。

- 灾害会带来更大损伤。

- 居民无法复活，无论身在避难所、废土还是任务中。

- 目标更苛刻，但奖励更丰厚。

- 任务更具挑战性。

EN: SURVIVAL MODE
ZH: 生存模式

EN: Hint: Move Pets around to the Dwellers that most need their bonuses.
ZH: 提示：将宠物派给那些最需要提升相关属性的居民。

EN:
Pets are found in Lunchboxes and Pet Carriers.

Pets provide a bonus effect to the Dweller they're assigned to and increase that Dweller's damage in combat. They can even tag along and help in the Wasteland.

Only one to three Pets are allowed in a room at a time, depending on the room's size.

Pets come in COMMON, RARE and LEGENDARY versions. The rarer the Pet, the greater its bonus effect, but even identical Pets might grant bonuses with different strengths.

Assign a Pet like you would equip a Weapon or an Outfit.
ZH:
宠物能够在午餐盒和宠物笼子中找到。

宠物能为所属居民提供加成效果、提升其在战斗中的伤害，还能跟随居民去废土上帮助。

一个房间里只允许有一到三只宠物，这取决于房间大小。

宠物也有普通，稀有和传奇三个等级。宠物越稀有，相关加成就越好。但即使是同样的宠物也有可能带来不同的加成。

像配备武器和装备那样指定一只宠物。

EN: PETS
ZH: 宠物

EN: Hint: Dweller attack rates are based on their Agility.
ZH: 提示：居民的攻击频率取决于他们的敏捷（A）。

EN:
Quests allow you to explore new locations, meet new Dwellers and collect loot.

Build the Overseer's Office room to send teams of Dwellers from your Vault on Quests.

To access the Quest List, tap the map icon from the Overseer's Office or from the Pip-Boy. The Quest List shows you your available Quests, their rewards, requirements and status. 

In Quests, explore the location by dragging Dwellers to new rooms, or just tapping on the room you want them to travel to.

Dwellers in combat fight automatically, but you can make them attack a specific enemy by tapping on a Dweller and then on the enemy. You can also tap and hold on a Dweller, then drag the target that appears to the enemy.

As your Dwellers fight they will build up a Critical hit meter; once ready, a checkmark icon will appear over the enemy that your charged Dweller is attacking; tapping it will let you unleash a deadly Critical Hit attack. 

Tap on the moving arrows that appear once they are in the center of the reticle, the closer the arrows are to the center, the higher the damage multiplier for your Critical Hit attack. 

The Critical Hit meters fills faster for higher Luck Dwellers and the Critical Hit arrows move slower the higher your Dweller Perception is.

You can see the mandatory and optional Quest objectives by tapping on the Map Icon in the top right corner.

When you're done exploring, tap on the Map Icon to return the Quest team to the Vault.
ZH:
任务能让您探索新的地点，遇见新的居民和收集战利品。

建造监督者办公室来派遣居民小队去完成任务。

点击监督者办公室里或者哔哔小子上的地图图标来进入任务列表。任务列表会显示您现在可以执行的任务，以及相对应的奖励，要求和状态。

在任务中，将居民拖到新房间中来探索或者直接点击您想要探索的房间。

居民会自动战斗，但是您可以先点击居民后点击敌人来让他们攻击一个特定目标。您也可以点击并按住一位居民，然后把出现的准星拖到敌人身上。

居民在战斗时会出现一个暴击蓄力器；一旦准备好，您的蓄力居民正在攻击的敌人上方会出现一个勾形图标，点击会对敌人进行致命暴击。

当箭头出现在十字线的中心时，请点击移动的箭头。离中心越近，暴击伤害的倍率就越高。

居民的运气（L）属性越高，暴击蓄力器的恢复速度也就越快。居民的观察力（P）属性越高，箭头移动的速度越慢。

点击右上角的地图图标查看必须完成和可选完成的任务目标。

当您结束探险时，点击地图图标让任务小队返回避难所。

EN: Hint: Some items cannot be found, only crafted.
ZH: 提示：有一些物品无法在探险时找到，只能通过打造。

EN:
You can use Junk and pay CAPS to craft items in the Weapon, Outfit and Theme Workshops.

COMMON, RARE and LEGENDARY Junk is found in Lunchboxes, in the Wasteland and on Quests, and produced by scrapping Weapons and Outfits. Rarer items require rarer Junk.

You also need an item's Recipe to craft it. Workshops start with some Recipes, but look for others on dead Raiders, in the Wasteland and on Quests.

Theme Recipes come in Fragments. Find these Fragments on Quests or use Nuka-Cola Quantum to complete your Theme Recipes.

Tap on a Workshop's Craft button to see the items you can make there and select the one you want. Upgraded Weapon and Outfit Workshops can craft RARE and LEGENDARY items.

All your Junk is refunded if you cancel the crafting process after it's started, but only part of the CAPS you spent.
ZH:
您可以利用杂物和瓶盖，在武器、装备和主题工坊中打造物品。

普通，稀有和传奇级别的杂物会在午餐盒、废土和任务中找到，分解武器和装备也能产出杂物。物品越稀有，需要的杂物就越稀有。

同时还需要打造物品的相应配方。工坊开始时会自带一些配方，其他的配方可以在死亡的掠夺者身上、废土探险或任务中找到。

主题配方以碎片形式出现。在任务中寻找这些碎片，或使用量子核子可乐来补全主题配方。

点击工坊的打造按钮可以看到能够打造的物品列表，选择您想要的。升级后的武器和装备工坊能够打造稀有和传奇级别的物品。

如果开始打造之后取消，您所用的杂物将全部返还，但花费的瓶盖只有部分返还。

Theme Recipes come in Fragments. Find these Fragments on Quests or use Nuka-Cola Quantum to complete your Theme Recipes.

Press [DU] in a Workshop to see the items you can make there and select the one you want. Upgraded Weapon and Outfit Workshops can craft RARE and LEGENDARY items.

All your Junk is refunded if you cancel the crafting process after it's started, but only part of the CAPS you spent.
ZH:
您可以利用杂物和瓶盖，在武器、装备和主题工坊中打造物品。

普通，稀有和传奇级别的杂物会在午餐盒、废土和任务中找到，分解武器和装备也能产出杂物。物品越稀有，需要的杂物就越稀有。

同时还需要打造物品的相应配方。工坊开始时会自带一些配方，其他的配方可以在死亡的掠夺者身上、废土探险或任务中找到。

主题配方以碎片形式出现。在任务中寻找这些碎片，或使用量子核子可乐来补全主题配方。

在工坊中按，可以看到能够打造的物品列表，选择您想要的。升级后的武器和装备工坊能够打造稀有和传奇级别的物品。

如果开始打造之后取消，您所用的杂物将全部返还，但花费的瓶盖只有部分返还。
